paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: figures/ablation_title.pdf
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores (%) of the MADLLM model and its variants across six different datasets—SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI—under various ablation settings. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score (%) on a scale from 60 to 100, while the horizontal axis lists the datasets. For each dataset, four bar types are shown: green for MADLLM, purple for MADLLM w/o feature embedding, blue for MADLLM w/o prompt pool, and orange for MADLLM w/o skip embedding. The results indicate that the full MADLLM model consistently achieves the highest F1 scores across all datasets, with performance decreasing when any of the components (feature embedding, prompt pool, or skip embedding) are removed. The highest F1 score is observed for the MADLLM model on the PSM dataset, exceeding 97%, while the lowest is for MADLLM w/o skip embedding on the WADI dataset, around 68%. The chart demonstrates the importance of all three components in achieving optimal performance.
